Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage Ceiling Pendant Lighting Fixtureand Clear Glass Shade - 7 x 7 x 17.25 Inches, 11.75 - 59.25 Inch Cord, Oil Rubbed Bronze
Colors: Oil-rubbed Bronze
Materials: Glass+Metal
A modern interpretation of classic vintage design provides style and grace. The rod and hood are metal with oil-rubbed bronze finish and a clear glass shade. Rods are included for height adjustment. 7"W x 7"D. Rods adjust height from 11.75"-59.25". Clear glass shade, metal with oil-rubbed bronze finish Will blend with traditional and modern styles. Ideal for bar area or kitchen island. Bulbs not included Professional installation recommended. Intended for indoor use only
